name: dsh-auto-evolve
description: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
